questions.solution:
Concept: Nernst equation, $E_{cell}=E^\circ_{cell}-\dfrac{0.059}{n}\log Q$ at 298 K.
Anode (oxidation): $\mathrm{HSnO_2^- + H_2O + 3OH^- \rightarrow Sn(OH)_6^{2-} + 2e^-}$
Cathode (reduction): $\mathrm{Bi_2O_3 + 3H_2O + 6e^- \rightarrow 2Bi + 6OH^-}$
Overall (anode reaction multiplied by 3): $\mathrm{Bi_2O_3 + 3HSnO_2^- + 3OH^- + 6H_2O \rightarrow 2Bi + 3Sn(OH)_6^{2-}}$, so $n=6$.
$E^\circ_{cell}=E^\circ_{cathode}-E^\circ_{anode}=-0.44\,\text{V}-(-0.90\,\text{V})=0.46\,\text{V}$
$E_{cell}=0.46\,\text{V}-\dfrac{0.059\,\text{V}}{6}\log 10^6=0.46\,\text{V}-0.059\,\text{V}=0.401\,\text{V}$
$E_{cell}\approx 4.01\times10^{-1}\,\text{V}$, so the nearest integer is 4.
Answer: 4
